title: Fall Commencement
description: Missouri State University holds its fall commencement ceremonies at Great Southern Bank Arena, honoring graduates of its colleges in two sessions: the Darr College of Agriculture, College of Business, College of Natural and Applied Sciences, and Interdisciplinary Academic Programs at 10 am, and the McQueary, Reynolds and Education colleges at 1:30 pm. No ticket is required, guest numbers per graduate are not limited, and guests go through security and may bring only clear bags. It takes place Friday, December 11, 2026, at 901 S. National Ave. in Springfield, MO, with doors opening 90 minutes before each ceremony and a livestream available.
address: Missouri State University, 901 S. National Ave.
